sources.title: Introducing GPT-5.5
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27. April 23 announcement and April 24 API update identify exact GPT-5.5. The inference-efficiency section discusses NVIDIA GB200/GB300 hardware, per-token latency and load balancing, but gives no total or active parameter count. Capability comparison tables report benchmark scores rather than parameter counts.

sources.title: GPT-5.5 API model documentation
sources.evidence: Reopened current exact documentation October 27. Identifies snapshot gpt-5.5-2026-04-23, text/image input, text output, 1,050,000 context, 128,000 max output, reasoning none/low/medium/high/xhigh with medium default, Chat Completions and Responses, function calling, computer use and prompt caching. No total or active parameter specification is given.

sources.title: GPT-5.5 System Card
sources.evidence: Original April 23 card, including April 24 and August 19 updates, reopened October 27. Sections 1-2 describe GPT-5.5 training and explicitly identify Pro as the same underlying model with parallel test-time compute. The complete 46-page text has no numerical total/active parameter disclosure; evaluation scores and test-time settings do not establish a count.

sources.title: GPT-5.6 System Card
sources.evidence: July 9 card with August updates reopened October 27. Its exact GPT-5.5 and Pro comparison columns give safety, vision, health, biology and other evaluation metrics, including corrected pass@4 results. Full 82-page text checked for parameter, activated-parameter and size disclosures; no GPT-5.5 total or active count is supplied.

sources.title: Self-replicating prompt injections exist
sources.evidence: September 25 original research reopened October 27. Exact GPT-5.5 is both vulnerable model and attack discoverer in a Slack evaluation using the Codex harness. GPT-5.4-mini-derived internal checkpoints are separately identified. The report supplies no GPT-5.5 total or active parameter count.

sources.title: Public Summary of Training Content for GPT-5.5
sources.evidence: July 29 public training summary reopened October 27. Section 1.2 explicitly says GPT-5.5 is not a modification or fine-tune of a prior model, so it supplies no counted-base lineage for nominal-size inheritance. Section 1.3 gives training-token/image quantities, not model parameters. The complete seven-page summary discloses neither total nor active parameters; training modalities do not establish API audio/video support.

sources.title: Prompt Caching 201
sources.evidence: Archived technical guide explicitly applies to models before GPT-5.6 and describes OpenAI prompt caching through Transformer attention key/value projections. Combined with exact GPT-5.5 caching support this supports only a broad qualified Transformer inference.

sources.title: File inputs
sources.evidence: Responses PDF processing for vision-capable models extracts text and page images; Chat Completions also accepts PDFs. This supports PDF as an API document format alongside the exact model vision and endpoint support, not an additional native modality.

sources.title: OpenAI API changelog
sources.evidence: April 24 explicitly releases GPT-5.5 to Chat Completions and Responses, with medium-default reasoning and extended prompt caching only. June 1 Bedrock expansion is later provider availability, not the original release.

sources.title: Model Release Notes
sources.evidence: October 14 retirement removes GPT-5.5 from ChatGPT, ChatGPT Work and Codex and explicitly does not affect API access.

sources.title: OpenAI API deprecations
sources.evidence: Current complete page checked for exact gpt-5.5 and its dated snapshot; no exact API shutdown notice found. Documentation alone is not an endpoint operation test.

sources.title: OpenAI Services Agreement
sources.evidence: Sections 2.2 and 9.1 provide limited hosted-service access and reserve service intellectual-property ownership, supporting descriptive Proprietary classification rather than a downloadable-weight license.

sources.title: OpenAI model inventory
sources.evidence: GPT-5.5 is listed among hosted models, distinct from the Open-weight section naming Apache-licensed gpt-oss models. Checked exact release and inventory offer no downloadable GPT-5.5 weights.

sources.title: Models.dev GPT-5.5 record
sources.evidence: Original catalog lead inspected via raw file; its generic family and promotional description are not treated as primary proof. Context, date and capabilities were independently checked.

sources.title: GPT-6 Astra System Card
sources.evidence: September 3 original system card freshly fetched October 27 and inspected through the complete PDF-text cache after the web reader rejected its 15.8 MB size. Exact GPT-5.5 Thinking comparisons include Table 4 vision safe-completion rates and monitorability/capability evaluations. No total or active parameter count appears in the full text; these comparisons give behavior metrics, not activated-parameter columns.

sources.title: Incompressible Knowledge Probes: Estimating Black-Box LLM Parameter Counts via Factual Capacity
sources.evidence: Original July 5 revision reopened October 27. Table 2 labels GPT-5.5 estimates as effective knowledge capacity in open-model-equivalent parameters with broad prediction bands; Appendix E leaves the exact gpt-5.5 parameter size and architecture blank. These behavioral estimates and inferred lineage are not published total or active model specifications and are rejected for both catalog counts.

sources.title: Research loops and self-improvement
sources.evidence: Original research page opened October 27 after exact-model active-parameter search. The July 14 experiment uses GPT-5.5 and other coding agents to modify an ML training codebase; Figure 4 tracks parameter counts of the models they construct during the loop. These are not GPT-5.5 weights or an active-count comparison of the coding agents, so no count transfers.

sources.title: GPT-5.5 inference specifications — unsupported count lead
sources.evidence: Secondary lead opened October 27. It asserts 700B total and 110B active with MoE/layer details, but supplies no primary architecture/count citation or original measurement supporting them; the displayed verification link concerns release/provider information. The assertions are not adopted as specifications or an original model-team comparison convention.

name.note: Official model name; Thinking is its ChatGPT presentation, distinct from GPT-5.5 Instant.

developer.note: Developer named in original release and technical publications.

family.note: Normalize to the named generation; no transfer of sibling counts or capabilities.

release_date.note: Earliest public ChatGPT/Codex release. API release followed April 24 even though its snapshot is dated April 23. Union-market date corroborates April 23.

open_weights.note: Hosted distribution under reserved service IP; no downloadable weights in the checked official release and model inventory.

license.note: Descriptive hosted-service classification, not SPDX or an open-weight license.

parameters_b.note: Fresh October 27 re-audit reopened original launch/API/card/training sources and later GPT-5.6/Astra comparisons, then searched exact GPT-5.5 total/active/activated counts and original arXiv research. No supported nominal total was found. The training summary rules out prior-model fine-tune lineage; IKP measures behavioral capacity, research-loop counts concern agent-built models, and the secondary 700B claim lacks primary support.

active_parameters_b.note: Fresh separate search found no supported GPT-5.5 nominal active count or original model-team activated-parameter table. Later OpenAI comparisons give evaluation metrics. The secondary 110B claim has no primary support, IKP estimates factual capacity, and research-loop active counts belong to constructed models. Neither total=active nor dense/MoE topology is inferred.

architecture.note: Qualified inference from exact prompt-caching feature and pre-GPT-5.6 Transformer KV explanation. This is a broad classification only; checked original/later technical and training evidence does not establish full block composition, dense/MoE topology or layer counts.

context_window.note: Exact API total context is 1,050,000 tokens with 128,000 maximum output. Do not derive a separate input ceiling by subtraction. Codex launch limit was 400K; product limits differ. No endpoint operation test.

modalities.note: Native text/image inputs and text output. PDF is an API format converted into extracted text and page images. Training audiovisual sources do not imply exposed audio/video support; hosted image generation is a tool, not native output.

reasoning.note: Exact API supports reasoning tokens and none, low, medium, high and xhigh effort; medium is default. Original card describes RL reasoning training.

tool_call.note: Exact model supports function calling and tools including computer use; no sibling inference.

description.value: OpenAI reasoning model for coding and general tasks, with text and image input, tool calling and computer use.
description.note: Replace unsupported current-default and promotional framing with documented purpose and capabilities.

patch.description: OpenAI reasoning model for coding and general tasks, with text and image input, tool calling and computer use.

sources.label: Public Summary of Training Content for GPT-5.5

patch.notes: Released April 23, 2026 in ChatGPT and Codex; API release followed April 24, with default snapshot gpt-5.5-2026-04-23. API context is 1,050,000 tokens with a 128,000-token output limit; Codex launch context was 400K. PDF denotes API extraction into text and page images. Transformer is a qualified broad inference from exact prompt-caching support and OpenAI pre-GPT-5.6 KV-cache documentation; full topology and total/active parameter counts remain undisclosed. The training summary identifies no prior-model fine-tune lineage and reports data quantities rather than parameter counts; behavioral size estimates are not specifications. October 14 retirement from ChatGPT, Work and Codex explicitly does not affect API access. No exact API shutdown notice was found; live endpoint operation was not tested.

summary: Fresh October 27 parameter-only re-audit retains undisclosed total and active counts after reopening original sources, later OpenAI comparisons and bounded exact-model searches. No counted-base lineage is documented; IKP behavioral estimates, agent-built research-loop models and unsupported secondary counts are rejected. Explicit null parameter patches and parameters_source are recorded; the other 12 field assessments are unchanged.
